name: primer-land-data
note: Map features for primer-land.html ('The land'), built 2026-10-25. Property 'map': 1 relief and region, 2 old coastline, 3 early roads, shrines and castles. Provinces are traced from modern prefecture lines and are approximate; present rivers are OpenStreetMap data (ODbL, credit 'OpenStreetMap contributors'); old rivers, roads and coastlines are sketches from written descriptions. WGS84 longitude/latitude.

properties.note: Province of Musashi, traced roughly from modern prefecture lines (Tokyo (without the islands) + Saitama + the Kawasaki/Yokohama part of Kanagawa; east of the Sumida was Shimōsa until the late 1600s.); the lines are approximate, not a survey of the old border.
properties.source: Data of Japan. (n.d.). land: japan.geojson [Data set]. GitHub. https://github.com/dataofjapan/land ; Geospatial Information Authority of Japan. (n.d.). 治水地形分類図 [Landform classification maps for flood control]. https://www.gsi.go.jp/bousaichiri/fc_index.html
